bio: Set within an imposing stone-faced building between Rosenborg Castle and the Designmuseum Danmark, démodé proves that good food is always in fashion. The dining room has a chic, elegant feel, but rather than the expected refined, dainty dishes, this is a place that serves hearty, generously proportioned combinations that are packed with flavour. Gallic cooking leads the way, so you might find rabbit terrine with sage, followed by daube de bœuf, then apple baked with rosemary and bay leaf. The all-French wine list boasts some hard-to-find older vintages, as well as a good selection by the glass....
